7.description: +[Arcane Thunder Seer] Arcane Thunder now requires fully channeling all 5 Arcane Missile projectiles to grant stack of Thunder Seer (they dont need to succesfully land on the target). This ensures that the damage output while fully stacked feels rewarding while fixing the exploit of rapid stacking of the buff.
+[Arcane Thunder Seer] Increased duration of Thunder Seer to 7 seconds. Up from 6.
+[Arcane Thunder Seer] Thunder Seer now reduces cast time of your Arcane Missiles by .375 (this reverts the previous nerf of 0.250 sec)
+[Arcane Thunder Seer] Arcane Thunder now increases damage of your Lightning Bolt by 5% and Chain Lightning by 4% per stack. (This no longer has lowered damage scaling against players)
